description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 24/08064 (Creation of new single front door; demolition and reconstruction of closet wing with enlarged basement; formation of rear extension link and infill extensions with rear terrace; fenestration alterations to rear elevation, comprising of new windows and Juliette balconies; improvements to roof form, together with external plant and glazed maintenance access hatch; and other associated works) to allow: adjustments to fenestration within lower ground floor lightwell; an increase in length of platform lift; re-proportioning of floor vent within eastern lower ground floor lightwell; adjustments to gutter detail of rear extension; and the addition of 4no. rooflights to the upper mansard pitched roof.
